tasks.title: Build the sweeper: lapse, overdue destroy, retention pruning and gauge recalibration
steps: Write TS-28-18, 19, 20, 30, 31 and 32 (TS-28-32 as a property test over generated states/ages; capture slog with a custom handler) and confirm they fail

Create internal/sandboxes/sweeper.go with type Sweeper holding db, provider, emitter, metrics, now func() time.Time, logger and a call timeout; method Sweep(ctx) runs steps in order via a list of named step functions, logging each step error with slog and continuing to the next
Step Reap: call provider.Reap under context.WithTimeout(callTimeout)
Step lapse: SELECT leased rows with COALESCE(lease_expires_at, expires_at) <= FormatUTC(now) and call endExpired for each (no provider call); a row ended by another path emits nothing
Step overdue: SELECT active rows with expires_at <= FormatUTC(now); endExpired destroys the box then ends as destroyed/expired even when Destroy fails
Step prune: DELETE FROM sandbox_leases WHERE state IN ('destroyed','expired','failed') AND COALESCE(ended_at, updated_at) < FormatUTC(now - 24h) (exactly 24h stays); never touch leased or active
Step recalibrate: Reset() afhub_sandboxes_active then Set one value per workspace from SELECT workspace, COUNT(*) FROM sandbox_leases WHERE state='active' GROUP BY workspace; nil metrics does nothing
Leave a clear insertion point for the orphan step between the overdue and prune steps (added in the next task); all reads use the injected clock only

tasks.title: Add the orphan step, sweep serialisation and per-call timeouts
steps: Write TS-28-16, 17, 21, 22 and 23 (recording provider double logging call order and in-flight Reap count; a hang option that blocks until ctx is cancelled) and confirm they fail

Add the orphan step: provider.List under the call timeout; load the set of terminal leases (id and sandbox_id) from this hub's table; Destroy a listed box when its ID equals a terminal lease's sandbox_id, or when the listing exposes labels and its hub.lease label names a terminal lease; never Destroy boxes of leased/active leases, boxes with no hub.lease label or an unknown lease id
Insert it between the overdue and prune steps so the order is Reap, lapse, overdue, orphans, prune, recalibrate; Destroy errors are logged scrubbed and the loop continues
Serialise Sweep with a sync.Mutex so two sweeps never overlap; endings that return changed=false emit nothing
Apply the per-call timeout (field default 30s, overridable in tests) to every provider call (Reap, List, each Destroy); on timeout log it with slog and continue to the next item and step
If the sandbox.Provider.List element does not expose Spec().Labels (unverified AgentKit shape), fall back to ID matching only, behind a small helper
Confirm Sweep returns after all six steps even when Reap and List both fail

Give the backend a reference to the Sweeper (interface with Sweep(ctx)) so it can be counted by a test double

tasks.title: Implement shutdown mode and the sandbox shutdown step
steps: Write TS-28-33..38 and TS-28-49 (TS-28-36 as a property test over random leased rows; TS-28-33 with a fake server whose Start returns at once and database handles that record Close order) and confirm they fail

Shutdown order: enter shutdown mode; cancel the reaper and wait for an in-progress sweep; select active leases and for each call provider Destroy then end as destroyed/shutdown, concurrently via a WaitGroup; stop waiting when the limit expires and leave unfinished leases active; never touch leased leases

In cmd/af-hub/main.go call svc.Shutdown after server.Start() returns, before the auditDB and database defers run (explicit call before returning, or a defer registered after both opens so it runs first), with the 20s limit; a log.Fatal path is unchanged
